## Release Highlights

- CLI environment integration now keeps managed workspace, tools, Python, encoder, and external-tool paths synchronized across new shells, with ownership tracking and workspace relocation support.
- Setup bootstrap now resolves supported Python 3.12-3.14 x64 installers dynamically, verifies downloads and signatures, repairs pip/vsrepo launchers, and stages VS plugin and tool installations atomically.
- Managed toolchains and external tools now use safer staged replacement, runtime validation, and ownership-aware uninstall behavior.
- DDP audio processing no longer fails on Chinese Windows when deew prints its GBK-incompatible logo.
- CI and release workflows use the current setup-dotnet action, and the dashboard header is more compact.

## Upgrade Notes

- Existing managed tools are migrated to their categorized workspace directories on first launch.
- FlowEncode only removes dependencies that its ownership manifest records as installed by FlowEncode; user-supplied components remain protected.
